messages:
Maria: Heads up — fridge is basically out of oat milk and the espresso portafilter is sticky. Coffee queue is quietly judging us. :coffee:
A.J.: I can do a quick run. Oat milk (2), extra beans if you want. Anything else? :wave:
Sam: Donuts or bagels for the afternoon pick-me-up? Vote please. :doughnut: :bagel:
Nina: Bagels pls. And can we please put a small sticker on the shared microwave about microwaving metal? Someone tried to reheat a container with foil yesterday. 
Josh: I'll bring a portafilter brush + descaler this afternoon and give the machine a quick scrub. Also FYI — please label personal containers. Leftover curry mystery is a biohazard. :grimacing:
Elena: @A.J. if you grab bagels maybe a few plain + one everything? And oat milk oat — not almond (I know controversial). :pleading_face:
A.J.: Ok grabbing 2 oat cartons, 6 bagels (2 plain, 2 everything, 2 cinnamon raisin), and a small bag of chocolate chip cookies. ETA 15:30. :truck:
KitchenBot: inventory_low alert — oat_milk=1 left, coffee_beans=0, sugar=2. Next scheduled restock in 21 hours.
Maria: Legend. If anyone wants almond milk instead let me know, otherwise stick to oat. Also can we add a note on the cabinet: "If you empty it, leave a sticky note with what you need" — saves us guessing.
Sam: Re: bagels, I'll bring cream cheese tubs to go with. Plain & chive?
Nina: Chive yes. Also reminder: no fish in the communal fridge after 18:00 please — the olfactory board will revolt.
Josh: Putting a small laminated sign on the fridge tonight. Also I'll post a tiny checklist for machine cleaning on the coffee shelf. :white_check_mark:
Elena: Thank you! @Josh amazing. @A.J. you're our hero. Payment for the run on the snacks kitty or Venmo?
A.J.: Snacks kitty is fine. I'll file receipt.
Maria: Awesome. Quick follow-up — anyone allergic to nuts? I want to avoid surprises with the cookies.
Sam: No allergies from me.
Nina: I'm nut-free, thanks for asking.
A.J.: Note in receipt: "bagels + oat milk + cookies (nut-free)".
Elena: Much appreciated. See you in 20. :coffee: :bagel:
